name: delhi-barapullah-zone-overrides
_comment: Receptor zones added by hand on top of what OSM leisure/landuse tags give. Use this for places people actually reach the water that carry no useful OSM tag - an informal crossing, a bank where children play, a stretch where the drain is used to wash animals. node_id may be left out; the compiler snaps the polygon centroid to the nearest stream node. population_upper_bound is an upper bound, never a count of identified people (PRD 14.2).

properties.name: Informal bank access, Barapullah at Sarai Kale Khan
